native_form_G5.matching_rule: a reference file counts when its full repository path appears in graphify's printed default answer as a whole path

questions_G6.matching_rule: file: whole path in the text; path::Name: one line holds the path and the last name part as a word; migration id: a migration file path with that prefix; table: whole word; route: URL path verbatim; doc line: doc path and line label on one line. Object keys pooled. Answer items = distinct candidates of the reference form named in the text (see tq_g.js). Conventions of tq_score.js (empty reference: recall 1; empty answer and empty reference: 1/1/1).

questions.rule: see tq_g.js: kinds the typed store's question program follows; tests_reach per question from the typed facts at the frozen commit

graphify.note: extract = `graphify extract --code-only --max-workers 6` inside the container (6 CPUs, 4 GB, network off); container = start, unpack, extract, copy, counts. graph.json only (the per-file AST cache was not kept).

typed_facts.note: meta.json timings_ms of the shared extractor (all stages it records: export, Python, TypeScript, documents, git history); built earlier by the facts lane under conditions not recorded here (not the same run, CPU limit or load as graphify), so times compare only roughly; stored = nodes.jsonl + edges.jsonl + commits.jsonl. Edges are evidence rows before the loader merges them.
